$comment: Every file that still decides on a role name, and how many lines (AGL-4047). apps/console/specs/role-name-gates-only-shrink.spec.ts holds each count exactly: a new role gate fails it, and converting one means lowering its count here in the same change. Only shrinks.

apps/console/app/(app)/[orgSlug]/setting.note: The Ownership and Delete sections are the owner’s: transferring and deleting the workspace are ownership itself.

apps/console/app/(app)/[orgSlug]/team/[u.note: Reads the TARGET member’s role: an admin spans every site, and the owner’s own row is not edited.

apps/console/app/api/_lib/usage-alert-em.note: Picks who a usage alert is mailed to.

apps/console/app/api/admin/lockdown/rout.note: Picks who a lockdown notice is mailed to.

apps/console/app/api/admin/users/manage/.note: Validates a platform staff role a staff request names.

apps/console/app/api/auth/sso-jit/route..note: Validates the default role an SSO connection assigns.

apps/console/app/api/hosts/members/permi.note: Protects the owner as the TARGET of a site permission edit.

apps/console/app/api/hosts/members/route.note: Validates the site role a request names.

apps/console/app/api/orgs/invites/route..note: Only the owner hands the workspace to someone else (an invite with the owner role, and its acceptance); also validates the site roles an invite names, and picks who a sender notice goes to.

apps/console/app/api/orgs/members/route..note: Validates the roles a request names, refuses assigning the owner role, and protects the owner as the target of an override.

apps/console/app/api/orgs/settings/route.note: Changing the workspace URL and transferring ownership are the owner’s.

apps/console/components/member-permissio.note: Locks the owner’s row as the target of an edit.

apps/console/components/org-members-card.note: The owner hand-off option is the owner’s; the other lines sort the roster by role, list the roles a member may be given, and keep the owner’s own row from being edited.

apps/console/components/settings/org-gen.note: The workspace URL field is the owner’s, as its route is.

apps/console/components/settings/org-own.note: Only the owner loads the list of people to transfer the workspace to.

apps/console/hooks/use-org-hosts.ts.note: Validates a site role read back from a membership row.

apps/console/hooks/use-org-permissions.t.note: An exported `isOwner` flag nothing decides access with.

apps/console/utils/over-limit-summary.ts.note: Validates a site role read back from a membership row.

apps/console/utils/server/lockdown-owner.note: Picks who a lockdown notice is mailed to.

apps/tenant/app/api/health/funnel/funnel.note: The health probe picks a member of its own test site.

libs/plugins/ai/src/lib/jobs/ai-layout-s.note: A list of job-title words for photo search, not membership roles.

libs/plugins/ai/src/lib/layout-language/.note: Layout placement roles, not membership roles.

libs/plugins/ai/src/lib/model/ai-permiss.note: The host roles the AI keys’ presets are tabled for.

libs/plugins/ai/src/lib/usage/ai-allotme.note: Picks who an allotment alert goes to.

libs/plugins/commerce/src/lib/server/pos.note: Platform staff roles (super, billing) on a staff page, not a member’s role.
Platform staff roles (super, billing) on a staff page, not a member’s role.

libs/plugins/domains/src/lib/server/doma.note: Picks who a domain email goes to.

libs/plugins/email/src/lib/components/se.note: Lists the owners and admins a sending address can be sent as.

libs/plugins/marketplace/src/lib/server/.note: Picks who a publisher review email goes to.

libs/tenant/data/admin/src/lib/server/no.note: Picks who a notification goes to.

libs/tenant/data/admin/src/lib/server/or.note: Picks who a member notice goes to.
The owner seat is never granted or demoted through these writes; that rule is about the TARGET row.

libs/tenant/data/admin/src/lib/server/ri.note: Picks who a risk notice goes to.

libs/tenant/data/admin/src/lib/server/tr.note: Counts the collaborators a site transfer leaves behind.

libs/tenant/data/admin/src/lib/server/we.note: Picks who the weekly summary goes to.
